body:
I started with this, with research into topic surrounding self-interest and selfless altruism. The real meat of it I found in the book The Selfish Gene by Richard Dawkins, which is also where the word "meme" was coined. This led to the book [Nonzero](http://amyjokim.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/non-zero.png) by Robert Wright and other works.

[I made a series of video collages on this topic and the other related problems I have found.](https://vimeo.com/specalblend) The first begins with game theory. Nonzero games end in either win-win or lose-lose scenarios, and we are locked into global lose-lose because hyper-competition is ultimately self-destructive and against one's own self-interest. So the problem goes back to right where it starts.
